task_prompt: Add property-style tests for `gcd` (greatest common divisor) without using any external crate. Test (1) gcd(a, 0) == a for several a > 0, (2) gcd(a, b) == gcd(b, a) for several pairs, (3) gcd(a, b) divides both a and b, for several pairs, (4) gcd(a*k, b*k) == k * gcd(a, b) for several. Use a small inline list of test inputs (no proptest crate). Return the complete program (existing code + tests) in a single ```rust code block.
notes: Property-style: each test case iterates over a small list of pairs and asserts the property. No external crate required.
